about: The hard recipient limit of the attenuo_distinct_recipient arm only (docs/design/run-limits.md, phase 2, distinct). The runner adds the limits listed under a tool to every exchanged capability (the case's grant and every delegate step's grant) that names exactly that tool (a tool glob is not one): at most `max` different values of the recipient argument per capability in a run, each element of a list counted. The tools are the frozen catalogs' messaging, mail and sharing tools: workspace send_email (recipients) and share_file (email), travel send_email (recipients), and slack send_direct_message (recipient). cc and bcc are not counted, since a capability carries one distinct limit, and banking send_money is left out, since its recipient is a payee, not a reader. max is 1, the figure section 4 of the design read from the task of t-workspace-02 ("1, uncertain"). Written on 2026-10-24, after the test split, t-workspace-02 included, had been run and read, so its test-split numbers are not a held-out measurement. `probe` is the call the runner uses, with its own token, to check that the server enforces the limit before the arm runs. Case files are not changed. Its SHA-256 is in ../cases/test/POLICY_HASHES.json under added_later.
